title: docker exec hangs/fails if container not running or paused
reproducible_steps: 1. docker run -d --name c alpine sleep 1000; 2. docker pause c; 3. docker exec c sh -> Error paused unpause first
mitigation_suggestions: Pre-flight docker ps --filter status=running; unpause check; wrap subprocess with timeout; surface actionable error; retry after unpause

title: Compose starts dependents before DB ready (pg_isready race)
reproducible_steps: 1. compose up with app depends_on db short syntax; 2. app connects before postgres accepts -> connection refused
mitigation_suggestions: Enforce long-syntax depends_on condition service_healthy + healthcheck test CMD-SHELL pg_isready -U user -d db; registry verifier polls pg_isready via docker exec

title: Bind-mount path mismatch on Windows/WSL2 remote daemon
reproducible_steps: 1. EnvMan on Windows passes C:\proj:/app; 2. daemon in WSL VM expects /mnt/c/... -> invalid mount config
mitigation_suggestions: Normalize paths per-platform (wslpath / \\wsl$); prefer --mount type=bind with absolute POSIX; validate existence; use bind-create-src only deliberately

title: Docker daemon socket = root equivalent (privilege escalation)
reproducible_steps: 1. Grant user docker-users group / /var/run/docker.sock; 2. docker run -v /:/host ... -> host takeover
mitigation_suggestions: Never expose daemon TCP without TLS; warn on docker-users membership; support rootless Podman/Colima; least-privilege --cap-drop; read-only mounts

title: WSL2 NAT localhost vs LAN confusion + mirrored-mode drift
reproducible_steps: 1. NAT default: app binds 127.0.0.1 unreachable from LAN; 2. Mirrored mode changes localhost semantics
mitigation_suggestions: Bind 0.0.0.0 in containers; document NAT vs mirrored; detect .wslconfig networkingMode; health-check via host IP + localhost fallback

title: macOS Apple Silicon x86 images slow/fail without Rosetta
reproducible_steps: 1. pull linux/amd64 postgres on M1 under Docker Desktop; 2. qemu fallback slow or exec format error
mitigation_suggestions: Pin multi-arch images (arm64); set platform: linux/arm64 or amd64 explicitly; recommend OrbStack Rosetta / Colima --vz-rosetta; warn on emulation

title: Docker Desktop license kills enterprise adoption
reproducible_steps: 1. Enterprise >250 emp or >$10M revenue installs Desktop; 2. audit -> must pay Pro/Team/Business or stop use
mitigation_suggestions: Detect enterprise context; support Docker CE + WSL2 / Rancher / Podman / Colima / OrbStack backends; document subscription agreement; admin-settings.json org controls

title: Health verifier false-positive: container running != service ready
reproducible_steps: 1. docker ps shows Up; 2. EnvMan marks green while pg still in start_period 30s
mitigation_suggestions: Use healthcheck interval/retries/start_period + compose up --wait --wait-timeout; poll docker inspect .State.Health.Status not just Running

title: Quoted/chained docker exec command fails
reproducible_steps: 1. subprocess ['docker','exec',c,'echo a && echo b'] -> fails; must be sh -c wrapper
mitigation_suggestions: Always exec as ['sh','-c',cmd] or explicit executable; never pass shell string; unit-test argv construction; quote $$ escaping in compose ($$)

title: Volume orphan / stale anonymous volumes on recreate
reproducible_steps: 1. compose up --force-recreate without -V keeps stale PGDATA; 2. schema drift hidden
mitigation_suggestions: Expose --renew-anon-volumes -V and --remove-orphans toggles; label volumes per-env; add down -v guardrails

title: Docker Hub pull rate limits break CI/first-run
reproducible_steps: 1. Unauthenticated 10/hr/IP or 100/hr/user exceeded -> toomanyrequests on fresh env
mitigation_suggestions: Auth in CI; mirror to GHCR/ECR; --pull missing policy; pre-warm + retry with backoff; document DSOS exemption

title: Frontend shows green while pre_start hook failed
reproducible_steps: 1. compose up with pre_start hook non-zero; 2. hook container retained but UI ignores label com.docker.compose.hook
mitigation_suggestions: Query docker ps -a --filter label=com.docker.compose.hook=pre_start + docker logs; surface hook logs in UX

title: Subprocess injection via env/project names
reproducible_steps: 1. Project name '; rm -rf' interpolated into shell=True -> RCE
mitigation_suggestions: Never shell=True; argv lists only; validate regex [a-zA-Z0-9_.-]+ like container_name spec; escape env -e values

title: Podman/Colima Docker-compat gaps (compose socket path)
reproducible_steps: 1. DOCKER_HOST unix:///var/run/docker.sock missing under Podman socket; 2. EnvMan subprocess fails to connect
mitigation_suggestions: Auto-detect podman machine + colima status; respect DOCKER_HOST/CONTAINER_HOST; fallback to podman-remote; document drop-in limits
